# Check footnotes extension for postprocessors
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['grep', '-n', 'Postprocessor\|postprocessor', 'markdown/extensions/footnotes.py'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print(result.stdout)
